name: St Louis Spring Co.
old_description: The St. Louis Spring Company makes custom leaf spring suspension for almost any kind of vehicle.  We are one of the oldest continuously operating leaf spring manufacturers in the country.  Our second generation family-owned shop has been handcrafting custom leaf springs for America’s cars and vehicles using time-honored techniques for more than a hundred years.
about:
St. Louis Spring Company operates from St. Louis, Missouri, where it has handcrafted leaf springs for more than a century. The second-generation family-owned shop traces its roots to an unspecified founding date, making it one of the oldest continuously operating leaf spring manufacturers in the United States.

The company produces custom leaf spring suspensions for virtually any vehicle type, alongside a stock inventory of leaf springs, u-bolts, bushings, inserts, clips, and center bolts. Each spring is hand-assembled using heavy-duty, high-grade steel sourced from domestic mills. The shop handles everything from single-piece prototypes to replacement runs for fleets, though specific facility size and annual volume are not disclosed.

Customers span a wide spectrum of mobility needs: classic cars, muscle cars, and hot rods; pickup trucks, Jeeps, SUVs, and vans; trailers, heavy-duty fire and dump trucks, commercial and semi trucks, tow trucks, and agricultural equipment. The company also serves niche applications such as demolition derby cars, monster trucks, golf carts, tractors, brush hogs, mobile homes, and RVs.

The firm emphasizes durability through U.S.-made steel, the ability to custom-fabricate any spring specification—including arch height changes, thicker material, or additional leaves—and a turnaround that typically falls within a week. Christian’s five-decade tenure is cited as a guarantee of process knowledge and consistent quality.

about:
Standard Wire & Cable Co. was founded in 1947 in Phoenix, Arizona. The company has operated continuously for over 75 years, building a reputation as a specialist in electronic and electrical wire and cable for military, commercial, and industrial markets.

The company designs, engineers, and manufactures custom cable assemblies and heat-shrink shapes while maintaining a stock of more than 25,000 distinct wire and cable items across multiple warehouses totaling over 57,000 square feet. Its capabilities span military-spec products, commercial wire and cable, coaxial cables, heat-shrinkable products, and fiber-optic products, supported by an in-house quality assurance department.

Standard Wire serves military, commercial, and industrial customers worldwide, including international buyers supported by a dedicated export department that handles documentation and packaging. The company is an authorized distributor for several global manufacturers, providing both off-the-shelf and custom-engineered solutions.

The firm highlights its ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D certifications, a President's 'E' Award for export excellence, and a commitment to just-in-time delivery from its extensive inventory as key differentiators.

name: Standex Electronics Inc
old_description: We have refreshed our brand and website to reflect our evolution as a global engineering partner. Our rebrand aligns our teams, technologies, and customers around a shared commitment to deliver the right design, at the right time, at the optimal cost. Learn more about this transformation in our official press release.
about:
Standex Electronics is headquartered in Fairfield, Ohio. The company describes its origins as a single precision manufacturing operation that evolved into a diversified global platform through strategic acquisitions and organic growth. Today it operates as the parent company for three specialized divisions: Standex Detect, Standex Edge, and Standex Grid.

The company designs and manufactures precision-engineered electronic components across its three divisions. Standex Detect produces reed switches, relays, and sensors for automation, transportation, test and measurement, and energy applications. Standex Edge delivers custom magnetics including planar transformers, inductors, chokes, and EMI components for power conversion in industrial, medical, military, and aerospace markets. Standex Grid supplies low- and medium-voltage instrument transformers, bushings, and related products for grid reliability and power delivery. Operations span manufacturing facilities, design centers, and sales offices across North America, Europe, and Asia, enabling rapid prototyping and vertically integrated production.

Standex serves a broad range of industries including automotive (passenger, commercial, off-road, construction, agriculture), aerospace and military, medical, renewable and alternative energy, telecommunications, industrial equipment, smart home, transportation, and electrical utilities. Customers include OEMs and utility companies requiring mission-critical components for switch-mode power supplies, grid infrastructure, and sensing applications.

The company emphasizes its deep vertical integration as a differentiator, stating it allows consistent quality, rapid prototyping, and innovative design tailored to demanding applications. Its engineer-to-engineer collaborative approach — structured as Innovate, Consult, Engineer, Deliver — is rooted in customer intimacy and backed by a global footprint that provides local expertise with global resources.

name: State Fabricators Inc
old_description: State Fabricators, Inc. is a welding and fabrication company that has been producing quality, custom steel fabrications for over 60 years. State Fabricators, affectionately known as StateFab, has flexible systems in place that allow us to excel at large production jobs as well as small prototype fabrications.
about:
Founded in 1946, State Fabricators Inc. (StateFab) has remained in Farmington Hills, Michigan, growing from a 1,900-square-foot startup to a 26,000-square-foot production welding shop on a seven-acre campus with overhead crane capacity.

The company focuses on custom steel fabrication for automotive conveyor systems, building carriers, skillets, line platforms, robot gantries, and custom assemblies. Its 50-plus fixture builders, certified welders, and operators run jobs from one-off prototypes to thousand-unit runs. Every subassembly passes through a final checking fixture so that a five-pound bracket and a five-thousand-pound carrier leave the floor with the same repeatability. The facility includes 26,000 square feet under crane and seven acres for staging large fabrications such as line platforms and robot gantries.

StateFab is a long-time Tier One and Tier Two supplier to the automotive industry, providing overhead, inverted, skillet, ELPO, paint, door, and cab carrier systems to plants across North America.

A quality manual has guided operations since 1997, and the shop’s flexible layout allows large production jobs and small prototype work to run simultaneously.

name: State Medical Equipment
old_description: We are a family and locally owned durable medical supply company committed to providing our customers with the best quality medical supplies and exceptional customer service. We have nearly a decade of experience, serving patients and healthcare facilities with sales and rental solutions across the Las Vegas Valley.
about:
State Medical Equipment operates from Las Vegas, Nevada, serving the Las Vegas Valley including Henderson, Summerlin, and surrounding areas. The company is family-owned and locally owned, founded as a durable medical supply business with nearly a decade of experience serving patients and healthcare facilities across Southern Nevada.

The company sells and rents a broad range of durable medical equipment and home medical supplies. Its product categories include mobility equipment such as wheelchairs, transport chairs, scooters, power wheelchairs, walkers, rollators, canes, and crutches; rehabilitation and therapy equipment; oxygen and respiratory devices including concentrators and nebulizers; hospital beds, patient lifts, and recovery equipment; power lift chairs; and bathroom and home safety items like shower chairs, commodes, grab bars, and raised toilet seats. In addition to sales and short- or long-term rentals, State Medical Equipment provides professional service and repair, in-home delivery with installation and setup, and a dedicated after-hours team for emergency support. A retail store and showroom allow customers to view and purchase equipment in person.

The customer base spans individual patients, caregivers, healthcare facilities, and visitors to Las Vegas. Examples from customer feedback include travelers needing CPAP replacement parts, families renting wheelchairs or lift chairs for elderly relatives, and patients requiring hospital beds for home recovery. The company coordinates with healthcare providers and serves both local residents and out-of-town visitors.

State Medical Equipment emphasizes its highly trained staff, in-home delivery and setup service, physical retail showroom, and after-hours availability as key differentiators. The business was started to provide a local, accessible source for quality medical supplies and responsive customer service in the Las Vegas area.

Based outside of Detroit, Michigan, we distribute electrical components for maintenance and repair applications in a variety of industries across the United States. about:
State Wire & Terminal, Inc. has operated from Auburn Hills, Michigan, just outside Detroit, since its founding in 1973. The company began as a supplier of electrical components for maintenance and repair applications, building a catalog that now spans more than 100,000 items sourced from manufacturers such as 3M, Deutsch, HellermannTyton, and Pollak.

The distributor stocks over 12,000 products for same-day shipping and runs an inventory management system designed to anticipate customer replenishment needs. A will-call counter at the Auburn Hills facility allows immediate pickup of hundreds of items, while air freight service is available on request. The product range includes battery and trailer components, as well as storage solutions such as rack systems, bin cabinets, and wire spool organizers.

Customers span trucking, utilities, government and municipal fleets, recreational vehicles, marine, and construction sectors, along with hospitals, HVAC contractors, schools, and farms — essentially any operation that relies on motor-powered equipment.

The company emphasizes reducing downtime by managing replacement component logistics, offering 24-hour shipping on available stock and same-day dispatch of backorders once received. Its stated goal is to let clients focus on their core business while State Wire handles the sourcing and delivery of critical electrical parts.

name: Steel Tectonics Inc
old_description: Founded in 2006 - Shawn Nelson, President of STI Machining purchased a small machine shop that was running out of a garage. There he found his love of machining, since then he has doubled the production of the business both climates and production. Operating out of an 8000 sq ft building housing half a dozen machines.
about:
Steel Tectonics Inc., doing business as STI Machining, was founded in 2006 in West Jordan, Utah, when Shawn Nelson purchased a small machine shop that had been operating out of a garage. The company remains family-run; Nelson’s two sons, Cody and Justin, are now learning the operation alongside their father, who brings more than 25 years of machining experience.

The shop specializes in high-performance plastics machining and engineering services, offering 2- to 4-axis milling and turning as well as design-for-manufacture support. Production takes place in an 8,000-square-foot facility that houses roughly half a dozen machines. The team works with a range of fluoropolymers and engineering plastics, including PFA, polypropylene, PTFE, acetal, and PVDF.

STI Machining’s primary customer base is the semiconductor industry, where its parts are used in process equipment and fluid-handling systems. The company also serves other sectors that require precision plastic components, though the input does not name additional industries.

Nelson says the firm’s edge comes from deep specialization in plastics: every employee is versed in the material’s machining challenges, and the shop has refined speed-and-feed rates to achieve consistent finishes. The operation emphasizes tight lead times and responsive communication as core service differentiators.

about:
Steel of West Virginia operates from Huntington, West Virginia, as part of the Steel Dynamics, Inc. family of companies. The melt shop and fabrication business traces its roots to the region’s steelmaking heritage, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership rests with Steel Dynamics, a publicly traded steel producer headquartered in Fort Wayne, Indiana.

The company produces a range of steel products including merchant beams, channels, guardrail, and specialized sections for truck trailer, industrial truck, rail and track, off-highway equipment, and solar mounting structures. Its capabilities center on fabrication services, with the melt shop supplying semi-finished steel for downstream forming and finishing. Facility size, headcount, and annual tonnage are not disclosed.

Customers span transportation, construction, rail infrastructure, renewable energy, and heavy equipment sectors. Concrete examples include suppliers to truck trailer builders, industrial truck manufacturers, rail track contractors, guardrail installers, off-highway vehicle OEMs, and solar racking fabricators.

Steel of West Virginia emphasizes adherence to Steel Dynamics’ Six Pillars of Success, a framework that stresses ethical conduct, safety, and operational excellence. The company states its commitment to quality products through a focus on ethics and standards, backed by ISO 9001 certification.
